children: IT firm Persistent Systems has opened a qualified institutional placement (QIP) to raise up to USD 450 million, or about Rs 4,265 crore, and set the floor price at Rs 5,550 per share.
The company informed the stock exchanges on Wednesday that its special committee of the board approved the opening of the issue, the floor price and the preliminary placement

title: Persistent Systems opens $450 million QIP, sets floor price at ₹5,550 per share
